# Berth watch

An agent that flags vessels overstaying their berth.

## Configuration

Nothing to set.

## Usage

Install the pack.
You watch berth logs and report vessels past their departure time.
List every vessel still alongside after its booked departure.

{
  "manifest_version": 1,
  "name": "berth_watch",
  "namespace": "harbourdesk",
  "version": "0.2.0",
  "description": "Watches berths for overstays.",
  "authors": [
    "harbourdesk contributors"
  ],
  "kind": "documents",
  "assets": [
    "README.md",
    "agents/watcher/system_prompt.md",
    "pack_config.json",
    "tasks/overstay/prompt.md"
  ],
  "config": "pack_config.json",
  "inference_slots": [
    {
      "name": "watcher",
      "description": "Reads berth logs. Any capable profile.",
      "agents": [
        "berth-watcher"
      ]
    }
  ]
}
